name: Layer 2 Scaling & Rollup Architecture
description: Scalability techniques including state channels, Optimistic Rollups (fraud proofs), ZK Rollups (validity proofs), Validium, Proto-Danksharding (EIP-4844), zkEVM circuits, and parallel execution.

subskills.name: State Channels & Payment Channel Networks
subskills.description: Off-chain transaction channels (Bitcoin Lightning Network, Raiden), opening/closing state transactions, dispute periods, and multi-hop routing.

subskills.name: Data Availability & CallData Optimization
subskills.description: Data availability problem, calldata cost mechanics in rollups, compression algorithms, and zero-byte calldata optimization.

subskills.name: Gas Profiling & Execution Cost Fundamentals
subskills.description: EVM opcodes gas costs, storage vs memory allocation, warm vs cold storage reads (EIP-2929), and gas profiling techniques.

subskills.name: Optimistic Rollups & Interactive Fraud Proofs
subskills.description: Optimistic execution model, single-round vs multi-round interactive fraud proofs (Arbitrum BOLD, Cannon), and 7-day challenge periods.

subskills.name: ZK-Rollups & Validity Proof Verification
subskills.description: ZK-Rollup architecture (Starknet, zkSync Era, Scroll, Linea), off-chain state transition proving, on-chain verification, and instant finality.

subskills.name: Validium, Volition & Sidechain Architectures
subskills.description: Validium architectures (off-chain DA with validity proofs), Data Availability Committees (DACs), Volition hybrid models, and autonomous sidechains.

subskills.name: Proto-Danksharding & Blob-Carrying Transactions (EIP-4844)
subskills.description: EIP-4844 blob-carrying transactions, KZG polynomial commitments, temporary blob storage lifespan, and decoupled blob gas market.

subskills.name: zkEVM Architecture & Types (Type 1 to Type 4)
subskills.description: Vitalik's zkEVM classification (Type 1 Ethereum-equivalent to Type 4 high-level-language-equivalent), polynomial arithmetic, and circuit efficiency tradeoffs.

subskills.name: Danksharding & Parallel EVM Execution Engines
subskills.description: Full Danksharding roadmap, Monad/Sei parallel execution engines, software transactional memory (STM), and optimistic concurrency for EVM.
